description: Relay settlement: RelayExecutor._pullOrderFunds takes the order address's ENTIRE Hub balance with no signed amountIn, so a malicious executor can pull more than the order authorized. The attacker sweeps the surplus to itself: the order was funded with 1000 tokenIn and the attacker swept +900 tokenIn beyond the order amount. RelayInbox MINT tops up the same order address across deposits, and refund residue left in the order address is re-pullable. Assessed S3/L2, approximately $15,000.
poc_notes: Executor PoC passed 5/5 in Foundry: order funded 1000 tokenIn drained to 0, attacker swept +900 tokenIn; exactly-funded control gains 0; RelayInbox MINT tops up the same order address across two deposits; refund residue is re-pullable. Destination-chain leg mocked; oracle double-attestation unproven.
title: _pullOrderFunds takes the order address's entire Hub balance with no signed amountIn
